figs.name: flow-characteristics-control-valve-inherent-curves-chart
figs.alt: control valve flow characteristics chart of quick opening, linear and equal percentage curves
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog plotting percent flow against percent valve travel for quick opening, linear and equal percentage trims at constant pressure drop.

figs.name: flow-characteristics-inherent-vs-installed-piping-diagram
figs.alt: inherent vs installed control valve flow characteristic piping diagram
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing the short test lab piping that gives the inherent characteristic with real plant piping where fittings and equipment change the valve pressure drop.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Inherent versus installed flow characteristic: test lab piping compared with real plant piping</title>
<rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Inherent vs Installed Flow Characteristic</text>
<rect x="20" y="60" width="760" height="150" rx="14" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="40" y="90" font-size="20" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Inherent: manufacturer test lab</text>
<rect x="60" y="130" width="250" height="26" fill="#cbd5e1" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<polygon points="310,118 360,143 310,168" fill="#15803d" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/><polygon points="410,118 360,143 410,168" fill="#15803d" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="410" y="130" width="60" height="26" fill="#cbd5e1" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="360" y="195" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Valve</text>
<text x="500" y="140" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Very short piping,</text>
<text x="500" y="166" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">constant pressure drop</text>
<rect x="20" y="230" width="760" height="250" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="40" y="260" font-size="20" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Installed: real plant</text>
<rect x="40" y="300" width="720" height="26" fill="#cbd5e1" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="110" y="366" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Pipe length</text>
<rect x="205" y="290" width="90" height="46" rx="6" fill="#fde68a" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="250" y="366" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Elbow, tee</text>
<polygon points="360,288 400,313 360,338" fill="#15803d" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/><polygon points="440,288 400,313 440,338" fill="#15803d" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="366" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Valve</text>
<rect x="495" y="290" width="90" height="46" rx="6" fill="#fde68a" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="540" y="366" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Exchanger</text>
<rect x="635" y="290" width="90" height="46" rx="6" fill="#fde68a" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="680" y="366" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Flow meter</text>
<line x1="40" y1="280" x2="120" y2="280" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="125" y="286" font-size="17" fill="#14532d" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">flow</text>
<text x="400" y="410" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Series losses rise with about the square of flow,</text>
<text x="400" y="440" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">so the valve pressure drop changes as the valve opens</text>
</svg>

figs.name: flow-characteristics-control-valve-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to select linear, equal percentage or quick opening control valve characteristic
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how to choose a valve flow characteristic: quick opening for on and off duty, linear for level, equal percentage for flow and pressure.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart for choosing a control valve flow characteristic by application</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#14532d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Choosing a Flow Characteristic</text>
<rect x="40" y="75" width="360" height="82" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="220.0" y="110.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">On and off or</text>
<text x="220.0" y="134.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">safety duty?</text>
<line x1="402" y1="116" x2="470" y2="116" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="436" y="106" font-size="17" fill="#15803d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="472" y="81" width="290" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#14532d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="617.0" y="122.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Quick opening</text>
<line x1="220" y1="159" x2="220" y2="183" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="240" y="177" font-size="17" fill="#6b7280" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="40" y="185" width="360" height="82" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="220.0" y="220.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Level loop or constant</text>
<text x="220.0" y="244.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">valve pressure drop?</text>
<line x1="402" y1="226" x2="470" y2="226" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="436" y="216" font-size="17" fill="#15803d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="472" y="191" width="290" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#14532d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="617.0" y="232.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Linear</text>
<line x1="220" y1="269" x2="220" y2="293" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="240" y="287" font-size="17" fill="#6b7280" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="40" y="295" width="360" height="82" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="220.0" y="330.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Flow or pressure loop</text>
<text x="220.0" y="354.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">with variable load?</text>
<line x1="402" y1="336" x2="470" y2="336" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="436" y="326" font-size="17" fill="#15803d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="472" y="301" width="290" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#14532d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="617.0" y="342.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Equal percentage</text>
<line x1="220" y1="379" x2="220" y2="403" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="240" y="397" font-size="17" fill="#6b7280" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="40" y="405" width="360" height="82" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="220.0" y="440.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Temperature loop or</text>
<text x="220.0" y="464.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">energy optimisation?</text>
<line x1="402" y1="446" x2="470" y2="446" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="436" y="436" font-size="17" fill="#15803d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="472" y="411" width="290" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#14532d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="617.0" y="452.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Modified parabolic or hybrid</text>
<line x1="220" y1="489" x2="220" y2="517" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="240" y="509" font-size="17" fill="#6b7280" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="40" y="519" width="722" height="64" rx="10" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#14532d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="401.0" y="557.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Engineered special case only: hyperbolic</text>
</svg>
